items.sender: The city tourism office sent you an email.
items.email:
Dear residents,
Next summer our city is going to hold a three-day festival to attract more tourists. There will be concerts, food markets and craft workshops. How do you feel about this plan? What do you think we should show visitors about our city?
Best regards,
The City Tourism Office
items.t11: Write a letter to your friend. Tell him/her how you feel about the festival and what visitors should see in your city. Write about 50 words.
items.t12: Write a letter to the manager of the tourism office. Say how you feel about the plan and what the city should show visitors and why. Write 120–150 words.
